title: Markdown content
description: A Markdown Resource's text is an asset (ADR 0142): its content is the URL form of the locator, /assets/<hash>, naming the text by the SHA-256 of its bytes. Export writes the text to the Aggregate directory's assets/<hash>.md while a Resource references it; a Resource keeps no text of its own, no path and no media type.

url.description: A stored text's content id: the SHA-256 of its bytes as unpadded base64url, 43 characters in canonical spelling.
